title: WikiFake
question: Who is lying?
description: A Wikipedia article, a handful of facts rewritten by a model, and you. Find them alone or against other players — a free game of critical reading and fact-checking.
noAccount: No account, no install. Play alone, or open a room and let other players in.

source.title: It starts with a real article
source.body: Name a subject and WikiFake pulls its article from French Wikipedia, exactly as it stands today. Nothing is trimmed and nothing is rephrased.
source.caption: From the article <source>“{topic}”</source>, unmodified.

collision.title: Then a model rewrites a few facts
collision.body: The sentences keep their shape and the paragraphs around them are left alone. Nothing is highlighted, and the article never says how many facts moved.
collision.caption: The same paragraph, once a round has been generated.
collision.tell: Here a single number moved: {truth} became {claim}. In a round, nobody points at it.

score.title: You mark what is wrong, and the clock is watching
score.body: Flag every paragraph you do not believe, then submit. Each mark is scored the moment the round ends.

outcomes.clock: Each second still on the clock
